## Skills

<div class="grid cards tx-reg-grid"><ul><li class="tx-reg-card">
<p class="tx-reg-head"><span class="tx-reg-icon">🧩</span>
<strong>Darshan I/O Analysis</strong> <span class="tx-reg-status tx-reg-status--experimental">experimental</span></p>
<p class="tx-reg-meta"><code>darshan-analysis</code>
<span class="tx-reg-owner">Baixi Sun — Argonne National Laboratory (ALCF)</span></p>
<p>Diagnose an HPC job&#x27;s I/O from its Darshan log: small or unaligned accesses, metadata and open storms, missing collective MPI-IO, rank imbalance, Lustre striping. Bundled tools fill a two-layer Darshan schema from the binary log, return exact facts as one card of measures per analysis concern, and do exact arithmetic, so the agent reports numbers retrieved from the log instead of estimating them.</p>
<p class="tx-reg-trigger">Say: &quot;analyze this Darshan log&quot;, &quot;why is my I/O slow&quot;, &quot;is this job I/O-bound&quot;, &quot;what bandwidth did &lt;job&gt; get&quot;, &quot;is rank 0 serialising the I/O&quot;, &quot;does it use collective MPI-IO&quot;, &quot;check the Lustre striping of &lt;log&gt;&quot;.</p>
<ul class="tx-reg-sub"><li><strong>Inputs:</strong> A .darshan binary log; optionally the node count, when DXT did not trace every rank.</li><li><strong>Outputs:</strong> Answers or a structured report in which every figure names the card it came from. Absent modules are reported as not applicable.</li><li><strong>Needs:</strong> Python 3.10 or newer and PyDarshan (pip install darshan; it needs libdarshan-util). The tools run as the darshan-tools MCP server (stdio) from the same repository, or as the darshan-tools command. No network access and no credentials.</li></ul>
<p class="tx-reg-domains"><span class="tx-reg-domain">hpc-io</span><span class="tx-reg-domain">darshan</span><span class="tx-reg-domain">io-performance</span><span class="tx-reg-domain">mpi-io</span><span class="tx-reg-domain">lustre</span></p>
<p class="tx-reg-links"><a href="https://github.com/Presciman">@Presciman</a> · <a href="https://github.com/Presciman/darshan-io-skill">source</a> · <a href="https://github.com/zhenghh04/trinity_hub/blob/main/registry/skills/darshan-analysis.yaml">YAML</a></p>
</li>
